answer: Surety admission with reputation decay stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a 60-coin sponsor-backed bond, and earns a score decaying 10% per epoch unless work renews it. A quartz-timed ledger records each epoch's pulse checkpoint, and a ferrous seal marks only renewed scores. Forging 100 identities locks 6,000 coins plus fees, and a caught fake slashes sponsor and newcomer together. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
